messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: paging triggered for service=model-serving-high-latency region=us-west-1 — 7 unique triggers, severity=high. PagerDuty incident PD-9012 created.

pagerduty: PD-9012 created and routed to #eng-oncall. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.

matt: acked on PD-9012 — looking. seeing a spike across the batcher nodes.

sasha: seeing alert storm — many dup alerts from the same root cause (kv-cache eviction). can we dedupe?

incident-bot: autosuppression attempted: grouping=service+region, window=60s. 7 alerts reduced to 2 pages.

matt: thanks. pushing a temporary suppression rule to avoid page storms while we triage.

ops-bridge-bot: silence created: latency-burst-suppression (10m) by matt. scope=us-west-1, reason="kv-cache thrash causing duplicate alerts".

elena: copying metrics while you work. running quick query on p99 latency and error rate.

matt: results: p50 ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 760ms, p99 ~ 2.3s. error rate still low (~0.4%), but tail latency hitting customers. major tenant affected: acme-corp (10% traffic).

sasha: customer-impact? need to know if any SLAs breached or active outages.

matt: SLA threshold (99th <1s) — we're breached. Filing incident customer-impact flag.

incident-bot: PD-9012 updated: impact=partial_degradation, affected_customers=["acme-corp"], status=investigating.

sasha: mitigation path: 1) scale up model-serving pool by +2 GPUs 2) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized variant 3) throttle non-critical batch jobs. I'll start 1 and 3. Matt, can you enable fallback?

matt: kicked off scale up via infra runbook: 
```
# increase pool
redwood-cli pools resize --name model-serving-usw1 --add 2
```
started — ETA ~90s for new instances.

matt: also toggled batching config to reduce per-request queuing:
```
# disable continuous batching for critical route
redwood-cli config set --route /v1/generate --continuous_batching false
```

incident-bot: PD-9012: escalation count=1 -> automated email to platform-support@redwood.com.

elena: scaled-up nodes are joining the pool. p95 dropping to ~420ms. good.

sasha: can someone confirm KV cache eviction logs? I suspect a GC/OOM loop on one of the cache nodes that caused thrash.

matt: tailing logs now: `journalctl -u kv-cache@node-7 -n 200` shows repeated OOMKill at 16:18:12. grabbing stack.

ops-bridge-bot: automation runbook note: if OOM on kv-cache node -> cordon & reprovision, enable persistence TTL tweak.

matt: cordoned node-7 and reprovisioning. expecting full traffic redistribution in ~40s.

incident-bot: PD-9012 acknowledged by matt at 1793501250. silence expires at 1793501850 unless extended.

sasha: once p95 stable <300ms for 5m, we can lift suppression and let true alerts pass through.

elena: current numbers: p95=290ms, p99=480ms, acme-corp error rate unchanged. looks stable for 2m.

matt: will extend suppression for 10 more minutes to avoid noise during handoff.

ops-bridge-bot: silence extended by matt; new expiry 1793502450.

pagerduty: PD-9012 note: incident status=mitigated; awaiting verification.

sasha: preparing handoff notes for night shift — capturing timeline + runbook steps + follow-ups.

sasha: HANDOFF PREVIEW:
- Root cause: kv-cache node OOM -> eviction thrash -> increased tail latency on batcher
- Immediate mitigations: scaled model pool (+2 GPUs), disabled continuous batching on critical route, cordoned node-7 and reprovisioned
- Customer impact: partial degradation for acme-corp; p99 briefly >2s; no request errors >5%
- Next actions: investigate memory pressure cause on kv-cache (heap leak or config?), add alert dedupe rule to incident-bot, increase eviction TTL defaults
- Owners: sasha (follow-up kv-cache), elena (customer comms if acme escalates), matt (sizing + infra fix)

elena: I'll draft a brief to account managers; will ping if acme requests an RCA.

matt: PD-9012 resolved (mitigated -> resolved) at 1793504120 after p99 <500ms for 10m. leaving a note to create postmortem.

incident-bot: automated housekeeping: grouped 7 alerts into 2, applied temporary silence, recorded actions to PD-9012. Suggested automation tweak: increase grouping window from 60s -> 120s for kv-cache-related alerts.

sasha: +1 on grouping window tweak. also add a dedupe policy: collapse alerts with identical root_cause tag within 3m.

matt: created follow-up ticket: RD-INC-2245 (postmortem + runbook updates + suppression tuning).

elena: small note on customer impact: flagged acme-corp as P1 contact for follow-up. I'll attach logs and metric graphs to the ticket.

sasha: ok. handing off to night oncall @elena at 1793504400 — please take over, escalate if tail latency rises above p99 1s.

elena: taking handoff. thanks team. leaving a short summary on the ticket. :thumbsup:

matt: great work. postmortem owners assigned. we'll track automation changes in RD-OPS board.

incident-bot: housekeeping complete: silence removed at expiry 1793502450 (was extended earlier). PD-9012 final state=resolved.

ops-bridge-bot: reminder: create a small canary test to exercise kv-cache mem patterns before rolling config changes. added to RD-INC-2245 checklist.

sasha: thanks all. closing thread.
